item.title: Creating a Debian Cloud-Init Template in Xen Orchestra
item.author: Unknown
item.description: Xen Orchestra (the manager for my XCP-NG based hypervisors) supports cloud-init for creation-time configuration of virtual machines. This guide walks through creating a cloud-init ready VM Template for Xen Orchestra using Debian 12.
